skill.description: Guides developers through building ChatGPT Apps with OpenAI Apps SDK widgets, FastMCP servers, widget metadata, and Developer Mode testing.

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, placeholder URLs, and API names. The real risks are limited to destructive local reset commands and templates that bind a development MCP server to all interfaces.

remediation.issue: Destructive reset commands use lsof piped to xargs kill -9.
remediation.suggestion: Replace them with safer commands that confirm the target process or use graceful termination before force killing.

remediation.issue: Example uvicorn servers bind to 0.0.0.0 for development.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users that this exposes the server on all interfaces and recommend localhost binding unless a tunnel requires otherwise.

remediation.issue: Development tunnel examples may expose local MCP tools.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to shut down tunnels after testing and avoid connecting tools that access private data.

content.value_statement: ChatGPT Apps require precise MCP metadata, widget HTML, and Developer Mode setup. This skill provides templates and debugging guidance for building interactive app experiences.
actual_capabilities: Explains the window.openai APIs for widget communication.
Provides FastMCP server templates for serving widget resources.
Shows how to attach openai.com/widget metadata to tool responses.
Documents Developer Mode registration with local tunnels.
Offers widget patterns for buttons, selection, and self-contained layouts.
Includes troubleshooting steps for caching, rendering, and connection issues.
limitations: Focused on ChatGPT Apps with widgets, not general MCP server design.
Examples assume Python FastMCP and may need adaptation for other stacks.
Local browser previews cannot fully reproduce the ChatGPT widget runtime.
Development tunnel setup requires external tools such as ngrok.

use_cases.title: Prototype a ChatGPT App
use_cases.description: Create a working MCP server and embedded widget for a new app idea.

use_cases.title: Add Rich UI to Tools
use_cases.description: Turn plain tool responses into visual widgets with structured content and metadata.

use_cases.title: Debug App Registration
use_cases.description: Diagnose why a ChatGPT App does not render, connect, or appear in mentions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic App
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a simple ChatGPT App with one FastMCP tool and one embedded widget. Explain each file I need.

prompt_templates.title: Design Widget Interactions
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a ChatGPT App widget for my use case. Include the window.openai APIs I should use and the response metadata I need.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Rendering Problems
prompt_templates.prompt: My ChatGPT App connects, but the widget stays loading. Walk me through the checks for MIME type, metadata, and server logs.

prompt_templates.title: Review an App Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my ChatGPT App architecture for widget caching, tool response structure, tunnel setup, and Developer Mode testing gaps.

output_examples.input: I need a starter ChatGPT App that displays a summary card.
output_examples.output: A step-by-step project outline with a FastMCP server, widget resource, tool response metadata, and local tunnel setup.

output_examples.input: My widget buttons do not work inside ChatGPT.
output: Use sendFollowUpMessage for reliable action buttons.
Check window.openai availability before calling APIs.
Retest in a fresh ChatGPT conversation after cache reset.

output_examples.input: I need to verify my app before demo day.
output_examples.output: A focused checklist covering server startup, tunnel URL, app registration, tool discovery, widget delivery, and MIME type.

best_practices: Keep widget HTML, CSS, and JavaScript self-contained for reliable rendering.
Use response metadata consistently so ChatGPT can locate the widget resource.
Test important changes in ChatGPT, not only in a local browser.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on complex widget click flows before testing them in ChatGPT.
Do not assume cached widgets update when the local server changes.
Do not expose development tunnels longer than needed for testing.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps build ChatGPT Apps that combine MCP tools with embedded HTML widgets.

faq.question: Does it create a complete production app?
faq.answer: No. It provides development templates and guidance that you must adapt, secure, and deploy yourself.

faq.question: Why does it mention ngrok?
faq.answer: ChatGPT needs a reachable MCP server during development, so the examples use a temporary tunnel.

faq.question: Can I test widgets in a normal browser?
faq.answer: Only partially. The window.openai API is available inside the ChatGPT widget runtime.

faq.question: Which programming stack does it use?
faq.answer: The examples focus on Python with FastMCP, plus HTML, CSS, and JavaScript widgets.

faq.question: Is this for standard MCP servers?
faq.answer: No. It is for ChatGPT Apps with visual widgets and app registration workflows.
